propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, metrics library, driver seams) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 and is intentionally not landed on main
The ~450-run live LLM batch replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise 50-ticket×3 candidate and current fresh runs) was permanently rejected on cost grounds

The verdict-perturbation measurement signal that the batch replay would have produced is now accumulated at zero marginal LLM cost by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder in merged change #798

History-based baseline mining is infeasible due to impact_model_version bump stranding sidecar baselines (~4 rows versus ~200 needed), making a live replay the only viable approach and justifying the cost rejection
The replay driver implements recall-stripped clones (copy store and delete REVIEW_RESULT.json files) and material-fingerprint drift guards to remove confounds from verdict perturbation measurement
The pure metrics library (criterion_deltas, tkey, build_matrix, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval, fp_control_valid) and golden tests are CI-collectable and LLM-free
